verification.notes: STATICALLY VALIDATED, NOT RUNTIME VERIFIED. Kiro is not installed in this environment. Kiro's docs disagree with themselves: the trigger reference says agentSpawn stdout is added to context on exit 0, the agent-configuration reference says nothing about stdout, and the hooks page shows a third schema (.kiro/hooks/*.json with trigger/action).

limitations: Kiro CLI only: hooks.agentSpawn lives in a custom-agent file, so the agent must be the one selected. The IDE 'Session Start' trigger is not implemented: its file format and whether its output reaches the agent are not documented clearly enough to claim.
The stdout-to-context behavior of agentSpawn is documented on one page and absent on another; not runtime verified.
resume/clear/compact are not documented for this trigger.

The hook-entry shape used (hooks.agentSpawn[{command}]) follows the agent-configuration reference example; it differs from the hooks page schema and from this repo's existing .kiro/hooks/detect-drift.json.
N2 (resources: file://session.md) was not chosen: nothing guarantees the file is fresh when Kiro loads it.
